rotationField.method: Direct Float64 Plummer sum from current massive particles; finite azimuthal average; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add.
rotationField.qualification: Axisymmetrised circular-speed diagnostic, not mean particle rotation or an observational curve. Negative inward support is retained as signed v² and shown as a gap in speed. Finite-N noise and angular-quadrature error are not removed.

laboratory.qualification: Read-only diagnostics of actual integrated states. Direct measurements exist only at audited snapshots; dashed segments are visual guides. Float64 energy evaluation does not upgrade Float32 trajectories.

capabilities.memoryHint: deviceMemory é uma estimativa arredondada de RAM; não mede VRAM.

webgpu.algorithm: direto O(N²); seleção automática depende de benchmark medido
